tests.scenario: machine contract and test matrix are valid, uniquely identified and cross-referenced
assertions: all clause IDs are unique
all test IDs are unique
every contract_ref resolves
all profile gate modes use the declared enum

tests.scenario: the same close fill is delivered three times
assertions: only the first delivery mutates state
realized_points and daily_realized increment once
the position aggregator contains one fill ID

tests.scenario: the same replay inputs are evaluated with different random decision UUIDs
assertions: position_id remains identical
a different logical entry receives a different position_id
runtime position_id is deterministic from the first accepted open-fill identity
backtest trades export position_id, close_fill_id and close_order_id for future cross-run parity

tests.scenario: a multi-lot position closes through multiple fills
assertions: every fill updates realized and session PnL
streak does not update before post-fill quantity reaches zero
finalize occurs exactly once after quantity reaches zero
the position result uses normalized sum of raw fill PnL
tests.runtime_coverage: RiskManager unit path plus CTA partial-close and reversal-checkpoint integration path

tests.scenario: partial close fills for one position occur in two RB risk sessions
assertions: each fill is assigned to its own session
daily_realized resets before the later-session fill is applied
position PnL aggregates across both sessions
streak updates once at finalization

tests.scenario: rounding boundaries and aggregation order
assertions: aggregate raw PnL 0.04 plus 0.04 normalizes to 0.1 and classifies win
aggregate raw PnL in the closed interval [-0.04, 0.04] normalizes to flat
slippage represented in fill prices is not deducted again

tests.scenario: restart after partial close and before position finalization
assertions: processed fill IDs and active aggregator restore
a replayed fill is ignored
a later fill completes the position and finalizes once
streak and PnL equal a no-restart reference run

tests.scenario: an Option D runtime snapshot mutates accounting fields but violates a state-machine invariant
assertions: load_state rejects the snapshot
the previously running RiskManager state remains field-for-field equivalent
no mixed accounting and Option D state is observable

tests.scenario: multiple state gates breach in one evaluation
assertions: all enabled gates are evaluated
all enforced and observed breaches are emitted
legacy reason equals the first enforced breach in stable order

tests.scenario: B0 observes four simultaneous state-gate breaches
assertions: the exposure-increasing leg is approved when hard prerequisites pass
four observed breaches and zero enforced breaches are emitted
existing execution shadow_mode is unchanged

tests.scenario: B1 reaches the consecutive-loss threshold while no other gate breaches
assertions: no consecutive-loss breach is evaluated or emitted
the exposure-increasing leg is approved
daily, cumulative and drawdown gates remain enforced

tests.scenario: B0 is missing a required risk session or drawdown equity observation
assertions: hard prerequisite failure blocks the open leg
observe mode never converts invalid input into approval

tests.scenario: position transitions 0 to 1, 2 to 1, 1 to 2 and 2 to -1
assertions: 0 to 1 is one open leg
2 to 1 is one close leg
1 to 2 is one open leg
2 to -1 is close 2 to zero followed by separately approved open 1 short

tests.scenario: a normal position loss reaches threshold and the next valid RB session arrives
assertions: state moves from ACTIVE to PAUSED_UNTIL_NEXT_SESSION
same-session open attempts remain blocked
state becomes PROBE_AVAILABLE only at eligible_from_session

tests.scenario: D experiment profile is compared with B1
assertions: D and B1 have identical gate modes
D adds only the frozen consecutive-loss probe policy
B1 is the declared direct control

tests.scenario: probe reservation, zero-fill cancellation, partial fill and restart
assertions: only one reservation exists per probe epoch
zero-fill terminal orders release reservation without consuming availability
first open fill enters PROBE_IN_FLIGHT
partial fill followed by cancellation remains PROBE_IN_FLIGHT
intent, probe identity, order IDs and position restore after restart

tests.scenario: probe finalizes as win, loss or flat
assertions: win resets streak and returns ACTIVE
loss increments the unsaturated true streak and pauses from the finalization session
flat preserves the true streak and pauses from the finalization session

tests.scenario: terminal order events and open trade callbacks arrive out of order
assertions: CANCELLED and ALLTRADED with reported volume retain the probe reservation until trade reconciliation
the CTA and pre-release live paths consume the probe only on the trade callback
REJECTED with zero fill releases availability
a later open fill is ignored and marks CTA recovery required

tests.scenario: a probe position receives a reversal signal and finalizes loss or flat
assertions: the close leg is never blocked by streak or account-state entry gates
probe finalization occurs before the reversal open leg is evaluated
loss or flat cancels the reversal open leg
no opposite open order is emitted

tests.scenario: a probe position receives a reversal signal and finalizes win
assertions: probe finalization occurs first and returns ACTIVE
the reversal open leg receives a fresh risk evaluation
a pre-close approval is never reused
the open leg is submitted only when all current checks approve

tests.scenario: 2018-2026 current one-lot full-exit baseline after risk-accounting refactor
assertions: 3658 decision rows
183 execution decision rows
10 trade rows
zero decision differences
zero trade differences

tests.scenario: 2018-2026 B0 continuous and fold diagnostic
assertions: decisions, fills and trades match a four-state-gates-disabled reference run
risk audit records all observed breaches
continuous and fold reports disclose every path difference

tests.scenario: 2018-2026 B1 continuous and fold diagnostic
assertions: only max_consecutive_losses enforcement differs from CURRENT_ENFORCED
daily, cumulative and drawdown enforced breaches are reported
continuous and fold reports disclose every path difference

tests.scenario: 2018-2026 D versus B1 continuous and fold-reset evaluation
assertions: D and B1 use identical gate modes, config hash and bar frame
3658 structural decisions match exactly in the continuous comparison
all six folds pass right-open and end_of_data completeness checks
D identity replay is exact for decisions, execution, trades, fills and probe identities
continuous and fold outcome deltas are disclosed without approving production adoption
